wsoauth-discord-desc: Log in with Discord through WSOAuth, binding each account to its Discord ID.
wsoauth-discord-cancelled: Login was cancelled on Discord. Nothing was changed.
wsoauth-discord-bad-state: This login didn't finish where it started: it began in another browser or app, took too long, or was used twice. Please open the wiki in your web browser and log in again.
wsoauth-discord-unreachable: Discord couldn't be reached, or didn't accept the login. Please try again in a minute.
wsoauth-discord-failed: Discord didn't confirm who you are. Please try logging in again.
wsoauth-discord-bad-name: Your Discord username can't be used as a wiki account name. Please ask a wiki administrator for help.
